faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kanpur Project Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the IIT Kanpur Project Engineer recruitment is 31st July 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Tech. degree or a B.Tech. degree with at least 3 years of relevant experience to be eligible for the Project Engineer position.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Engineer post at the Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur through this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Engineer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Engineer post will receive a consolidated salary ranging from Rs. 31,600 to Rs. 49,800 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIT Kanpur Project Engineer recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Engineer role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Engineer position at IIT Kanpur will primarily involve an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur, which is www.iitk.ac.in.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I attach with the application form?
faq.answer: You should attach self-attested copies of required documents such as your photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant educational/experience certificates with the application form.

faq.question: Q10. Where should I send the completed application form?
faq.answer: The completed application form, along with all necessary documents, should be sent to the address mentioned in the official notification through Speed Post or Registered Post.
